features.description: Change 1: kitchenEquip — Add T1 phone-guided steps before T2 system checks (PowerPause sticker check, interlock panel green light, MCB check)
verification_steps: Step 1: Start kitchenEquip flow — first question asks about PowerPause sticker
Step 2: Selecting NO routes to GK Repairs referral with phone number
Step 3: Selecting YES proceeds to interlock panel green light check
Step 4: Green light ON → press button → branches to resolved / appliance fault / contactor fault
Step 5: Green light OFF → MCB check → branches to reset / hardware fault
Step 6: No panel visible → proceeds to T2 system checks (existing flow)
features.notes: Interlock panel image placeholder needed (MISSING asset)

features.description: Change 2: tooCold — Add T1 with pub/accommodation branch, soft pushback, Salus thermostat visual aids
verification_steps: Step 1: Start tooCold flow — first question asks pub or accommodation
Step 2: Pub branch pulls live zone data, shows soft pushback if temp at setpoint
Step 3: Customer insists → boost applied with reason capture
Step 4: Accommodation branch shows Salus thermostat image, walks through icons
Step 5: Background rule flags non-standard setpoints in review ticket
features.notes: Salus thermostat image available as visual aid

features.description: Change 3: noHotWater — Soft pushback for early calls, pub/accommodation, boiler visual check
verification_steps: Step 1: Start noHotWater flow — asks what time site opens
Step 2: If calling before expected HW time, soft pushback with reason capture
Step 3: Asks pub or accommodation
Step 4: Boiler visual check — error codes / pilot light questions
Step 5: Boiler fault routes to GK Repairs + IoT Support
Step 6: Boiler looks fine → proceeds to T2 system checks

features.description: Change 4: keepsTurningOff — Add T1 (interlock light check, single vs multiple, timing pattern)
verification_steps: Step 1: Start keepsTurningOff flow — asks about green light on interlock
Step 2: Green light stays on → appliance fault → GK Repairs
Step 3: Asks single vs multiple appliances
Step 4: Multiple → site power issue referral
Step 5: Asks if happening at same time daily
Step 6: Yes → schedule check, Random → device status → escalate

features.description: Change 5: ovensGrills — Replace 'not remotely controllable' with PowerPause scope check
verification_steps: Step 1: Start ovensGrills flow — asks about PowerPause sticker
Step 2: YES → routes to kitchenEquip flow
Step 3: NO → GK Repairs referral with phone number
Step 4: UNSURE → asks about switch boxes/green light → routes accordingly

features.description: Change 6: heatingStuck — Add T1 with pub/accommodation branch, Salus standby, stuck valve detection
verification_steps: Step 1: Start heatingStuck flow — asks pub or accommodation
Step 2: Accommodation → Salus standby instruction (hold OK 3s) with thermostat image
Step 3: Resolved → still creates review ticket
Step 4: Pub → radiator check → stuck valve detection → GK Repairs + IoT escalation
Step 5: System shows heating actively calling → T2 remote setpoint reset

features.description: Change 7: controlsIssue — Add T1 branching by control type (Salus blank, interlock, boiler error)
verification_steps: Step 1: Start controlsIssue flow — asks which type of control
Step 2: Salus blank → USB charge + OK hold with thermostat image
Step 3: Interlock panel → same steps as kitchenEquip T1
Step 4: Boiler error code → capture code + QR scan → escalate with details

features.description: Change 8: fridgeIssue — Add scope clarification (monitoring only), door check, temp thresholds
verification_steps: Step 1: Start fridgeIssue flow — shows monitoring-only scope message
Step 2: Asks about door left open
Step 3: Asks temperature reading from unit display
Step 4: T2 checks ThingsBoard sensor data
Step 5: Escalation flags food safety concern if temp >8C fridge or >-15C freezer

features.description: Change 9: NEW externalLighting flow — Tongou switch, MCB, Tuya device status/override
verification_steps: Step 1: externalLighting appears in entry points under Hardware > Lighting
Step 2: T1 asks about switch box / manual override
Step 3: MCB/fuse check
Step 4: T2 checks Tuya device status and schedule
Step 5: Online + in schedule → override → resolved
Step 6: Online + out of schedule → override + review ticket
Step 7: Offline → escalate (connectivity/hardware fault)

features.description: Change 10: wontTurnOn — Add total power failure check before equipment type routing
verification_steps: Step 1: Start wontTurnOn flow — first asks if anything else is working
Step 2: Nothing working → site power issue → refer to GK Repairs
Step 3: Other things working → proceeds to equipment type routing

features.description: Change 11: Structured handoff — Add T1 checks completed, findings, suggested diagnostic flow, ruled out, non-LH referral fields to triage summary
verification_steps: Step 1: Complete any flow that escalates
Step 2: Triage summary includes T1 Checks Completed section
Step 3: Triage summary includes T1 Findings from handler input
Step 4: Triage summary includes Suggested Diagnostic Flow reference
Step 5: Triage summary includes What's Been Ruled Out
Step 6: Triage summary includes Non-LH Referral Made if applicable
features.notes: Additive to existing ticket fields, not replacing

features.description: Change 12: somethingElse — Add contractor detection and re-routing to known categories before free-text
verification_steps: Step 1: Start somethingElse flow — first asks about contractor on site
Step 2: Contractor YES → captures details → priority escalation
Step 3: No contractor → asks what issue is about
Step 4: Matches known category → routes to that flow
Step 5: Genuinely unknown → free-text capture → escalate

features.description: OOH entry points updated — all new/modified flows accessible from landing page with correct categories
verification_steps: Step 1: Landing page shows Lighting category under Hardware with externalLighting flow
Step 2: Landing page shows all existing categories updated with new flow IDs
Step 3: 'Something else / unsure' routes to somethingElse flow (not contractor-escalation)
Step 4: All problem-based entries present: freezing, hot water, won't turn on, scope check, something else

features.description: Escalation terminology consistent across all flows — single route to IoT Support, GK Repairs as advisory referral only
verification_steps: Step 1: All escalation states route to IoT Support (not direct to GK Repairs/SCC/Flowrite)
Step 2: GK Repairs mentioned as advisory referral with consistent phone number 0345 603 4566
Step 3: Escalation messages use consistent terminology across all flows
features.notes: Design principle: all escalations to IoT Support, agent advises GK Repairs separately
